notes.title: Patch Note (V1.6)
notes.content:
New:

-Updated the main menu with a "Future Contents" section
-Added the settings menu
-Moved the music volume controller into the settings menu
-Added a cursor selector section in the settings menu (coming soon)
-Removed the random messages
-Changed the position of the counter and warning message
-Added a new space on the main screen for upgrades
-New upgrades added:
Auto Gift (2 min) [200 Coins]: Automatically opens the gift box every second, as long as you have enough coins
Double Speed (1 min) [500 Coins]: Tired of normal speed? Speed things up by doubling the timer speed
Triple Speed (1 min) [750 Coins]: Go even faster with 3x timer speed


Fixes:

-Fixed some button collision issues
-Fixed upgrades not stacking correctly
-Fixed an issue causing the main menu music not to loop


Known Issues:

-Upgrade timers don't save when quitting the game

notes.title: Patch Note (V1.55)
notes.content:
New:
-Added 2 new themes
-Increased the wait time between mystery gift openings (0.25s → 0.33s)
-Decreased the price of the mystery gift (5 coins → 3 coins)
-Modified the probabilities for the mystery gift:
30% chance to get +2 coins
25% chance to get +4 coins
20% chance to get +6 coins
15% chance to get +1 second on the current timer
7% chance to get +2 seconds on the current timer
3% chance to get +3 seconds on the current timer

Fixes:
-Fixed an issue causing the themes menu to sometimes not display correctly
-Fixed an issue causing the "void" theme to show a different theme

notes.title: Patch Note (V1.5)
notes.content:
New:
-Added a main menu
-Added different music for the main menu
-Added a new cursor
-Modified the probabilities for the mystery gift:
40% chance to get +1 coin
30% chance to get +3 coins
20% chance to get +7 coins
7% chance to get +1 second on the current timer
3% chance to get +2 seconds on the current timer
-Modified the quit button
-Added a confirmation menu when quitting

Fixes:
-Fixed an issue where the first 8 themes in the shop appeared as bought
-Fixed an issue causing some achievements to not trigger properly

Known Issues:
-On restart, bought themes are not displayed as such, but they are still owned by the player

notes.title: Patch Note (V1.45)
notes.content:
New:
-Added 4 new themes
-Added a "Reload Themes" button in the themes menu
-Modified the prices of all themes (now increments of 1000)
-Decreased the wait time between mystery gift openings (1s → 0.25s)
-Changed the background of elements on screen for better visibility

Fixed:
-The reload button now fixes the issue of missing owned themes at startup
-Improved how the game loads and saves data (may still cause some issues)

notes.title: Patch Note (V1.4)
notes.content:
New:
-Added a new gameplay feature: the Mystery Gift!
-The Mystery Gift opening price is currently set to 5 coins, with the following possible rewards:
	50% chance to get +3 coins
	20% chance to get +7 coins
	15% chance to get +10 coins
	10% chance to get +1 second on the current timer
	5% chance to get +2 seconds on the current timer
-Added a 1-second delay between Mystery Gift openings to prevent spamming
-Added a UI element on the main screen to display the winning prize when opening a Mystery Gift

Fixes:
-Fixed some scripting issues

notes.title: Patch Note (V1.35)
notes.content:
New:
-Graphical redesign of the shop and themes menu
-Updated the appearance of several fonts
-Modified the backgrounds for main screen elements
-Background colors of main screen elements now match the default theme
-Added a coin logo
-Replaced static theme selection with a sliding interface
-Added exit icons to the shop and themes menu
-Added a temporary section to warn about current issues

Fixes:
-Fixed an issue where the starting theme was incorrect
-Fixed an issue where the default background theme sometimes appeared blue instead of gray

Known issues:
-When restarting the game, bought and owned themes do not appear. The player must click on a theme in the shop again to make them reappear.

notes.title: Patch Note (V1.3)
notes.content:
New:

-Added the shop menu
-Added 8 new themes
-Added the themes menu
-Added a new currency: coins
-Changed the default background color for better visibility
-Added 2 new achievements

Fixes:
-Fixed an issue that caused the save file to reset on launch
-Fixed an issue that prevented the themes menu from displaying correctly

Known issues:
-On launch, the previously selected theme may sometimes default to the original one
-On rare occasions, the default background theme may appear blue instead of gray
-The "bought" text sometimes doesn't appear when purchasing a theme
